name: Commodore Amiga 500

technical_context.memory: original base configuration commonly represented as 512 KiB; expansions and revisions vary
technical_context.executable_or_load_model: Amiga executable/load behaviour depends on Kickstart/AmigaOS environment and media
technical_context.filesystem: AmigaDOS filesystem behaviour is OS/media dependent
technical_context.boot_process: Kickstart firmware establishes the machine environment, then boot media or attached storage supplies software; no Kickstart/Workbench bytes are included.
technical_context.rom_or_os_assumptions: Kickstart and AmigaOS/Workbench are historically material dependencies, but their proprietary bytes are not embedded.

documented_software_behaviour: software may coordinate CPU, DMA, raster and custom chips
boot behaviour depends on firmware and media
